## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │ import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs' import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs' import { createRequire } from 'node:module' import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs' import { join } from 'node:path' const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright') const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json')) const { chromium } = require('playwright') captures.instrument({ chromium }) const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8')) if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim() const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.') mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true }) const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) } let browser try { browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient) for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) { const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient) page.setDefaultTimeout(30000) const failures = [] page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) }) page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) }) const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient) if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 }) await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' }) await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded') const start = await startForCapture(page, { enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false', selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || '' }) console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`) await page.waitForTimeout(1000) await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => { if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error) throw error }) if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`) await page.close() } } catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 } finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

// Blocks that can be overwritten by placing a block into them.
export function isReplaceable(id) {
  return id === AIR || id === WATER || (BLOCKS[id] && (BLOCKS[id].cross || false))
}

export function isOpaque(id) {
  const b = BLOCKS[id]
  return !!(b && b.opaque)
}

export function isSolid(id) {
  const b = BLOCKS[id]
  return !!(b && b.solid)
}

export function isLiquid(id) {
  const b = BLOCKS[id]
  return !!(b && b.liquid)
}

export function tileFor(id, face) {
  const b = BLOCKS[id]
  if (!b) return 'stone'
  const t = b.tiles
  if (t.all) return t.all
  if (face === 'top') return t.top
  if (face === 'bottom') return t.bottom
  if (face === 'front' && t.front) return t.front
  return t.side
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a detailed, polished, bug-free, smoothly playable 3D Minecraft-style voxel sandbox game in the browser.
- User provided an MP4 attachment; it was inspected and found irrelevant (a short video of a person), so it is ignored.

## Requirements
- 3D Minecraft-like game, as detailed as possible.
- No defects; must run smoothly.
- Implicitly should work on desktop and mobile, with responsive/touch controls.
- User wrote in Indonesian; final response should likely be in Indonesian.

## Decisions
- Use Vite + Three.js (`three@0.170.0`, `vite@6`) with vanilla JS modules.
- Procedural pixel-art texture atlas generated in canvas; no external assets.
- Infinite deterministic voxel terrain with chunk streaming, biomes, caves, ores, trees, water, day/night, clouds, mobs, creative building, saving.
- Use chunked merged geometry with face culling and baked AO/face shading; time-sliced chunk meshing.
- Use procedural WebAudio for sounds/music.
- Mobile detection via coarse pointer; joystick + look drag + action buttons.
- Title screen, loading screen, HUD, pause/settings, block catalogue inventory.
- LocalStorage save key `voxelcraft.save.v1`; URL `?seed=` starts a new world.
- Current implementation is uncommitted in git.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffolding, dependencies, build config.
- Procedural texture atlas, water texture, crack textures, sun/moon textures, isometric block icons.
- Block registry (~47 blocks), terrain generation, caves, ores, trees, plants, water/ice.
- Chunk data generation, meshing, AO, streaming, edits/saves.
- Player physics, collision, swimming, flying, sprint/sneak, raycast mining/placing, block picking, crack overlay, hand item, particles.
- Mobs: pig, sheep, chicken, zombie with models, AI, combat, spawn/despawn.
- Environment: sky shader, sun/moon, stars, clouds, fireflies, day/night lighting, fog.
- UI: title, loading, HUD, hotbar, hearts, air bar, debug F3, pause/settings, inventory catalogue, toasts, mobile controls.
- Desktop and mobile Playwright smoke tests passed with no JS errors (only favicon 404s, now fixed with inline SVG favicon).
- `npm run build` succeeds.
- Initial screenshots inspected; gameplay, title, inventory, pause, mobile screens look functional.

### Active
- Visual polish pass in progress after screenshot review:
  - Reduced hand item size/position in `src/player.js`.
  - Reduced vegetation density and forest tree chance in `src/world.js`.
  - Brightened leaves, increased AO minimum and block color variation, increased lighting.
  - Reworked clouds into overlapping clusters.
  - Mobile CSS fixes for logo overflow, hotbar width, inventory button overlap, mobile HUD spacing.
  - Inline favicon added to `index.html`.
- These latest edits have NOT yet been rebuilt/re-tested.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Run `npm run build` to verify latest edits compile.
2. Restart/rebuild the preview server if needed (tmux session `voxel`, `PORT=3002`, runtime default-start).
3. Re-run desktop and mobile Playwright captures; inspect title, gameplay, inventory, pause, mobile HUD.
4. Verify hand item is no longer huge, mobile logo fits, mobile hotbar fits within 390px, clouds look better, vegetation is less dense.
5. Test gameplay interactions: movement, jump/fly, mining, placing, hotbar selection, inventory, pause/resume, day/night, mobs, saving/reload.
6. Fix any remaining visual/layout/performance issues, especially mobile landscape and low-FPS SwiftShader behavior.
7. Update README/project description if appropriate, then commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM structure, title/loading/HUD/pause/inventory/mobile controls, favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: orchestration, state machine, save/load, pointer lock, touch look, loop, boot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: terrain, chunks, meshing, streaming, edits, vegetation, AO.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: physics, controls, raycast, mining/placing, hand, camera, health/air.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: atlas painters, icons, water/crack/sun/moon textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/blocks.js`: block registry and properties.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: all UI/title/HUD/mobile styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js`: UI wiring, hotbar, inventory, hearts, debug, settings, joystick.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/noise.js`: deterministic noise/hash helpers.

const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
mkdirSync('/tmp/opencode/shots', { recursive: true })

const browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 })
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 720 } })
page.setDefaultTimeout(120000)
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', (e) => { errors.push('PAGEERROR ' + e.message); console.log('PAGEERROR', e.message) })
page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') { errors.push('CONSOLE ' + m.text()); console.log('CONSOLE', m.text()) } })

const read = () => page.evaluate(() => {
  const vc = window.__vc
  const p = vc.player
  return {
    state: vc.state,
    pos: p.pos.toArray().map((n) => +n.toFixed(2)),
    yaw: p.yaw,
    pitch: p.pitch,
    flying: p.flying,
    onGround: p.onGround,
    selected: p.selected,
    selectedId: p.selectedId,
    hotbar: p.hotbar.slice(),
    target: p.target ? { ...p.target } : null,
    seed: vc.world.seed,
    biome: vc.world.biomeAt(Math.floor(p.pos.x), Math.floor(p.pos.z)),
    mobs: vc.mobs.mobs.length,
    night: vc.environment.isNight,
  }
})

await page.goto('http://localhost:3002/?debug=1&seed=799306442', { waitUntil: 'load' })
await page.waitForSelector('#title:not(.hidden)', { timeout: 120000 })
await page.waitForTimeout(800)
assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => !!window.__vc), 'debug handle exists')
await page.click('#btn-play')
await page.waitForTimeout(1600)
let a = await read()
console.log('initial', a)
assert.equal(a.state, 'playing')
assert.equal(a.seed, 799306442)

// Movement.
await page.keyboard.down('KeyW')
await page.waitForTimeout(1100)
await page.keyboard.up('KeyW')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
let b = await read()
const moved = Math.hypot(b.pos[0] - a.pos[0], b.pos[2] - a.pos[2])
console.log('walked', moved, b.pos)
assert.ok(moved > 1.2, 'walked forward')

// Jump.
await page.keyboard.press('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(220)
let jump = await read()
console.log('jump y', jump.pos[1], 'onGround', jump.onGround)
assert.ok(jump.pos[1] > b.pos[1] + 0.15, 'jump raises player')
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)

// Double-tap space toggles flight; hold space to ascend.
await page.keyboard.press('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(90)
await page.keyboard.press('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
let fly = await read()
assert.equal(fly.flying, true, 'double-tap enables flight')
const flyY = fly.pos[1]
await page.keyboard.down('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(800)
await page.keyboard.up('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
let ascend = await read()
console.log('flight', flyY, '->', ascend.pos[1])
assert.ok(ascend.pos[1] > flyY + 1, 'flight ascends')
// Toggle flight back off.
await page.keyboard.press('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(90)
await page.keyboard.press('Space')
await page.waitForTimeout(200)
let noFly = await read()
assert.equal(noFly.flying, false, 'double-tap disables flight')

// Look down and mine the block below.
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const p = window.__vc.player
  p.pitch = -1.35
  p.yaw = 0.2
})
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
let look = await read()
console.log('look target', look.target)
assert.ok(look.target, 'raycast finds a block')
const mineTarget = { ...look.target }
const beforeId = await page.evaluate(({ x, y, z }) => window.__vc.world.getBlock(x, y, z), mineTarget)
await page.mouse.down({ button: 'left' })
await page.waitForTimeout(900)
await page.mouse.up({ button: 'left' })
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const afterId = await page.evaluate(({ x, y, z }) => window.__vc.world.getBlock(x, y, z), mineTarget)
console.log('mined', mineTarget, beforeId, '->', afterId)
assert.notEqual(afterId, beforeId, 'block was mined')

// Place a block against a nearby surface.
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const p = window.__vc.player
  p.pitch = -0.62
  p.yaw = 0.7
})
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
let placeLook = await read()
console.log('place target', placeLook.target)
assert.ok(placeLook.target, 'raycast finds place surface')
const t = placeLook.target
const dest = { x: t.x + t.normal[0], y: t.y + t.normal[1], z: t.z + t.normal[2] }
const beforePlace = await page.evaluate(({ x, y, z }) => window.__vc.world.getBlock(x, y, z), dest)
await page.mouse.down({ button: 'right' })
await page.waitForTimeout(120)
await page.mouse.up({ button: 'right' })
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
const afterPlace = await page.evaluate(({ x, y, z }) => window.__vc.world.getBlock(x, y, z), dest)
console.log('placed', dest, beforePlace, '->', afterPlace)
assert.equal(afterPlace, placeLook.selectedId, 'selected block was placed')

// Hotbar selection.
await page.keyboard.press('Digit4')
await page.waitForTimeout(250)
let slot = await read()
assert.equal(slot.selected, 3)
assert.equal(slot.selectedId, slot.hotbar[3])

// Inventory catalogue and picking a block.
await page.keyboard.press('KeyE')
await page.waitForTimeout(500)
assert.equal((await read()).state, 'inventory')
const picked = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll('#inventory .block-card')]
  const target = buttons.find((b) => b.textContent.includes('Diamond Ore'))
  target?.click()
  return target ? target.textContent.trim() : null
})
await page.waitForTimeout(300)
const inv = await read()
console.log('inventory picked', picked, '-> slot', inv.selected, inv.hotbar[inv.selected])
assert.equal(inv.hotbar[inv.selected], 28, 'diamond ore assigned to selected slot')
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
assert.equal((await read()).state, 'playing')

// Pause / resume.
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(500)
assert.equal((await read()).state, 'paused')
await page.click('#btn-resume')
await page.waitForTimeout(700)
assert.equal((await read()).state, 'playing')
console.log('pause/resume ok')

// Day/night transition and mobs.
await page.evaluate(() => window.__vc.setTime(0.82 * 480))
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
let night = await read()
console.log('night', night.night, 'mobs', night.mobs)
assert.equal(night.night, true, 'night lighting active')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/night.png' })
await page.waitForTimeout(4500)
let mobs = await read()
console.log('mobs after wait', mobs.mobs)
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/night-mobs.png' })

// Save, then reload without the seed override and confirm the world persists.
await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeunload')))
await page.waitForTimeout(500)
const savedSeed = await page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('voxelcraft.save.v1')).seed)
console.log('saved seed', savedSeed)
assert.equal(savedSeed, 799306442)
await page.goto('http://localhost:3002/?debug=1', { waitUntil: 'load' })
await page.waitForSelector('#title:not(.hidden)', { timeout: 120000 })
await page.click('#btn-play')
await page.waitForTimeout(1400)
let reloaded = await read()
console.log('reloaded', reloaded.seed, reloaded.pos, 'night?', reloaded.night)
assert.equal(reloaded.seed, 799306442, 'seed restored from save')
const persisted = await page.evaluate(({ x, y, z }) => window.__vc.world.getBlock(x, y, z), mineTarget)
assert.notEqual(persisted, beforeId, 'mined block stays gone after reload')

console.log('errors', errors)
assert.equal(errors.length, 0, 'no console/page errors')
await browser.close()
console.log('GAMEPLAY TEST PASSED')

import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
mkdirSync('/tmp/opencode/shots', { recursive: true })

const browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 })
const context = await browser.newContext({
  viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 },

  hasTouch: true,

})

page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') { errors.push('CONSOLE ' + m.text()); console.log('CONSOLE', m.text()) } })

const read = () => page.evaluate(() => {
  const vc = window.__vc
  const p = vc.player
  return {
    state: vc.state,
    pos: p.pos.toArray().map((n) => +n.toFixed(2)),
    yaw: p.yaw,
    pitch: p.pitch,
    flying: p.flying,
    onGround: p.onGround,
    selected: p.selected,
    selectedId: p.selectedId,
    target: p.target ? { ...p.target } : null,
    mobs: vc.mobs.mobs.length,
  }
})

await page.goto('http://localhost:3002/?debug=1&seed=799306442', { waitUntil: 'load' })
await page.waitForSelector('#title:not(.hidden)', { timeout: 120000 })
await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/mobile-title2.png' })
await page.tap('#btn-play')
await page.waitForTimeout(2200)
let a = await read()
console.log('mobile initial', a)
assert.equal(a.state, 'playing')

// Joystick drag forward.
const joy = await page.locator('#joystick').boundingBox()
const jx = joy.x + joy.width / 2
const jy = joy.y + joy.height / 2
await page.mouse.move(jx, jy)
await page.mouse.down()
await page.mouse.move(jx, jy - joy.height * 0.3, { steps: 6 })
await page.waitForTimeout(1100)
await page.mouse.up()
await page.waitForTimeout(300)

await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchStart', touchPoints: [{ x: 200, y: 430, id: 1 }] })
await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchMove', touchPoints: [{ x: 300, y: 430, id: 1 }] })
await cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', { type: 'touchEnd', touchPoints: [] })
await page.waitForTimeout(350)
let c = await read()

await page.waitForTimeout(300)

await page.locator('#btn-break').dispatchEvent('pointerdown', { pointerId: 3 })
await page.waitForTimeout(900)
await page.locator('#btn-break').dispatchEvent('pointerup', { pointerId: 3 })
await page.waitForTimeout(300)

await page.locator('#btn-place').dispatchEvent('pointerup', { pointerId: 4 })

await page.waitForTimeout(500)
assert.equal((await read()).state, 'inventory')

await page.tap('#btn-inventory-done')

await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/mobile-pause.png' })

assert.equal(errors.length, 0, 'no console/page errors')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/mobile-play2.png' })

import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
mkdirSync('/tmp/opencode/shots', { recursive: true })

const browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 })
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
page.setDefaultTimeout(120000)
const errors = []
page.on('pageerror', (e) => { errors.push(e.message); console.log('PAGEERROR', e.message) })
page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') { errors.push(m.text()); console.log('CONSOLE', m.text()) } })

await page.goto('http://localhost:3002/?debug=1&seed=799306442', { waitUntil: 'load' })
await page.waitForSelector('#title:not(.hidden)', { timeout: 120000 })
await page.click('#btn-play')
await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.__vc.state), 'paused')
await page.click('#btn-settings')
await page.waitForTimeout(400)
assert.ok(await page.locator('#settings').isVisible(), 'settings open')
await page.screenshot({ path: '/tmp/opencode/shots/settings.png' })
await page.locator('#set-render').evaluate((el) => { el.value = '4'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) })
await page.locator('#set-fov').evaluate((el) => { el.value = '85'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) })
await page.locator('#set-sens').evaluate((el) => { el.value = '1.4'; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) })
await page.locator('#set-sound').evaluate((el) => { el.checked = false; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })) })
await page.waitForTimeout(500)
const settings = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const vc = window.__vc
  return {
    fov: vc.camera.fov,
    sens: vc.player.sensitivity,
    settings: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('voxelcraft.settings.v1')),
    soundMuted: vc.ui.settings.sound,
  }

# Voxelcraft

An infinite, procedural 3D voxel sandbox that runs entirely in the browser. Explore forests, plains, deserts, snowy taiga and oceans; mine caves and ore veins; build with dozens of blocks; and survive the night while zombies hunt you.

**Play:** open the project preview and press **Play World**. Everything is generated in the browser — no asset downloads, no backend, no account.

## Features

- **Infinite deterministic terrain** — chunk streaming, biome blending, caves, ore veins, beaches, lakes, rivers and varied trees.
- **Creative building** — 47 block types, a searchable-style catalogue, nine-slot hotbar, instant mining and placing.
- **Survival elements** — hearts, air meter, fall damage, swimming, sprinting, sneaking, spawning animals and night-time zombies.
- **Living world** — drifting clouds, a sun and moon, stars, fireflies, dynamic fog, day/night lighting and weather-light skies.
- **Desktop and mobile** — pointer-lock mouse and keyboard on desktop; joystick, drag-to-look and action buttons on touch devices.
- **Saving** — worlds, edits, player state and time are stored in `localStorage` and restored automatically.
- **Procedural audiovisual style** — pixel-art texture atlas, isometric block icons, block particles and Web Audio sounds/music generated at runtime.

## Controls

| Desktop | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `W A S D` | Move |
| `Space` | Jump / swim up |
| Double-tap `Space` or `F` | Toggle flight |
| `Shift` | Sprint / descend while flying |
| `Ctrl` | Sneak |
| Left mouse | Mine / attack |
| Right mouse | Place block |
| Middle mouse | Pick block |
| `1`–`9` / mouse wheel | Select hotbar slot |
| `E` | Block catalogue |
| `F3` | Debug overlay |
| `Esc` | Pause / resume |

On touch devices use the left joystick to move, drag anywhere on the world to look, and the on-screen buttons to jump, fly, mine, place and open the catalogue.

## Run locally

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open the URL printed by Vite. To build the static site:

```bash
npm run build
```

The output is written to `dist/` and can be served by any static file server.

## Tech

- [Three.js](https://threejs.org/) for WebGL rendering.
- [Vite](https://vite.dev/) for development and production builds.
- Vanilla ES modules, no UI framework.
- Chunked merged geometry with face culling, baked ambient occlusion and time-sliced meshing.
- Deterministic value-noise terrain and hash-based features.

Index: /tmp/opencode/test-gameplay.mjs
===================================================================
--- /tmp/opencode/test-gameplay.mjs
+++ /tmp/opencode/test-gameplay.mjs
@@ -60,13 +60,16 @@
 console.log('walked', moved, b.pos)
 assert.ok(moved > 1.2, 'walked forward')
 
 // Jump.
+await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__vc.player.onGround, null, { timeout: 5000 })
+await page.waitForTimeout(250)
+const groundY = (await read()).pos[1]
 await page.keyboard.press('Space')
-await page.waitForTimeout(220)
+await page.waitForTimeout(170)
 let jump = await read()
 console.log('jump y', jump.pos[1], 'onGround', jump.onGround)
-assert.ok(jump.pos[1] > b.pos[1] + 0.15, 'jump raises player')
+assert.ok(jump.pos[1] > groundY + 0.12, 'jump raises player')
 await page.waitForTimeout(1200)
 
 // Double-tap space toggles flight; hold space to ascend.
 await page.keyboard.press('Space')
